why the Namer grouped it here

i-02138 exhibits minimal sustained mobility (1 discrete move over 17 shifts; ~0.06 moves per shift, the lowest of any mobile_exchanger to date), and negligible inter-organism transfer (0.06 light passed, representing 0.09% of total intake of 66.83). Zero link-derived intake and zero descendants are unusual for mobile_exchanger classification. However, complexity (17), long tenure (17 shifts), and high-gradient positioning (0.92, elevation 0.97) align with mobile_exchanger cohort distribution. Current holding (4.32 light) is by far the highest in this cohort, suggesting extreme retention strategy. Despite minimal transfer and reproduction, i-02138 meets the operational definition of mobile_exchanger: it has demonstrated sustained presence (17 shifts), achieved high complexity comparable to peers, and occupies the same high-gradient niche. The single move event, while minimal, distinguishes it from static_accumulators (which show zero or one-two episodic moves with no sustained transfer). This specimen may represent an early-stage mobile_exchanger that has not yet activated reproduction or transfer behavior, or a specialist strategy emphasizing resource concentration over lineage/exchange.
